summary: The Kidney Care Access Protection Act amends title XVIII of the Social Security Act to improve Medicare coverage and payment systems for end-stage renal disease (ESRD), innovative dialysis drugs and equipment, staffing adjustments, and kidney disease education and screenings.

affected_groups.effect: Gain improved access to innovative drugs, biological products, equipment, supplies, and kidney disease education benefits.
affected_groups.group: Medicare beneficiaries with end-stage renal disease

affected_groups.effect: Receive revised transitional and permanent add-on payments for innovative treatments, direct payments under Medicare Advantage, labor market basket adjustments, and separate payments for kidney disease education services.
affected_groups.group: Renal dialysis facilities and providers of services

affected_groups.effect: Subject to direct payment adjustments made by the Secretary to providers or dialysis facilities for enrollees with end-stage renal disease receiving transitional innovative therapies.

key_provisions: Extends transitional drug add-on payment adjustments (TDAPA) for new renal dialysis drugs and biological products for at least three years starting in 2026.
Establishes a permanent post-TDAPA payment add-on to the base rate for new and innovative renal dialysis drugs and biological products.
Extends transitional add-on payment adjustments for new and innovative equipment and supplies (TPNIES) for at least three years, including certain breakthrough devices and capital-related assets.
Requires direct payment adjustments under Medicare Advantage for enrollees with end-stage renal disease receiving transitional innovative therapies.
Implements a forecast error adjustment for the annual renal dialysis payment increase factor starting in 2026 when price changes exceed 0.5 percentage points.
Expands the Medicare annual wellness benefit to include chronic kidney disease screening.
Increases access to the Medicare kidney disease education benefit by expanding eligible providers and adding renal dialysis facilities as approved providers.
missing_information: Specific dollar amounts or exact fiscal impacts of the payment adjustments.
Detailed criteria the Secretary will use to define chronic kidney disease screening.
summary_detail.plain_summary: The Kidney Care Access Protection Act amends title XVIII of the Social Security Act to improve Medicare coverage and payment systems for end-stage renal disease (ESRD), innovative dialysis drugs and equipment, staffing adjustments, and kidney disease education and screenings.
summary_detail.significance: The legislation alters Medicare payment structures for renal dialysis services, drugs, and devices, while expanding preventative screenings and educational benefits for kidney disease under title XVIII of the Social Security Act.
